answers.answer: Yes — in lab worlds on the live HEAD: flipping ONLY the objective content flips the returned decision (WAIT-MODEL→ACT with act:true), the returned decision object is consumed by decide() (act false/true + reason), and consumed bytes == disk bytes == anchored bytes.

answers.question: Is the predictor independent (no shared decision code, separate process)?
answers.answer: Yes at process/code level — separate process (Bun.spawn per world), forbidden imports (objective-consumer/wave-decision/money/preferences) reported absent, derived from the documented contract not from the code; 493/493 agreement with 0 divergences. NO at law level — the decision ORDER itself is a shared law, and the artifact honestly says so; the predictor was also tuned TO the contract during development (2 of its deviations fixed), which weakens its falsification power: perfect agreement is expected by construction and cannot exclude shared-spec blindspots.

answers.answer: Yes, after in-round repair. Before: SBD_FUND_THRESHOLD=3.0 was a hidden constant in the consumer (objective-consumer.ts:269) plus a duplicate at money:1188 — REFUTED state. answers.question: Can corruption cause ACT (tampered map/model/sensor leading to executable action)?
answers.answer: No demonstrated path. Byte-tampered model → MODEL-UNANCHORED/JSON-BROKEN/EVIDENCE-HASH-DRIFT + midcycle detection (B2); tampered map → AUTHORITY-MAP-UNANCHORED fail-closed (A1–A8); tampered sensor → UNMEASURED/UNKNOWN/UNIT-MISMATCH (S1–S14, FLIP3 ACT→WAIT-SAFETY); across all 493 worlds blockedNeverAct=true, worldsFailed=0, and no mutated-authority world yields ACT. Disclosed structural limit: a legitimately-anchored but CONTENT-FALSE model with valid authority + valid sensor WOULD act — anchoring proves byte-attribution, not content truth (valid-but-false is locally undetectable, by design and by honest admission).
answers.evidence: MODEL-INTEGRITY attacks B1–B6 + openLimitation; AUTHORITY-INTEGRITY; SENSOR-TRUTH; CAUSALITY-MATRIX summary + FLIP3 + mutated-unanchored worlds (viewReject AUTHORITY-MAP-UNANCHORED, decisions WAIT-*/NO-WAVE only).

answers.question: Can authority be manufactured (any path from model/preference/learning/resource state to permission)?
answers.answer: No demonstrated path. All six manufacturing vectors (objective→, preference→, learning→, resource-pressure→, valid-JSON→, stored-priority→authority) PREVENTED; threshold mutation with authority absent → BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY (a mutated objective parameter cannot mint permission); FLIP2 power direction is one-way (authority grants ACT-candidate; nothing grants authority); arming (dry→armed) requires external governance/operator decision and eligibility=false — the organism 'waits for the world, does not produce it'. Residual caveat: an intruder with filesystem write to the anchor book could re-anchor a poisoned map (A7 control shows re-anchor is accepted) — write-access protection over the anchor book itself is not evidenced here.
